newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Acindar signs $75 mln standby loan.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Acindar signs $75 mln standby loan.

text.p: Argentine steelmaker Acindar said Monday it has signed a $75 million standby loan agreement with the International Finance Corp.

In a statement, the company said the loan was split into two, with a $25 million tranche acquired directly from the International Finance Corp. The remaining $50 million has been syndicated with a group of European banks.
The loan will be used for the early redemption of a $150 million bond maturing in November 1998 which has a call option in November this year.
The standy-by loan will paid off in semi-annual payments between May 1999 and Nov 2003, said Acindar.
